recruiterCard.summary: Built a C#/.NET service on the Automation Team that reconciles SQL Server check records against a payment-status REST API and flags mismatches.
impactBullets: Cut manual check-record verification from 5–10 minutes to under one minute for 8–15 internal UAT users.
Added validation, timeouts, retries, cancellation, and fallback messaging so failing upstream calls degrade clearly.
Used parameterized SQL queries and a composite index, and wrote 20–30 unit and integration tests that caught edge cases before production.
Added logging that reduced diagnosis time by 50–70%.
